issues.description: Silent semantic change: coerceNumber maps null/undefined to 0 where old toNumber/identity propagated null/NaN.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The original passed toNumber as lift and accessors.identity as ground, so non-numeric domain entries produced NaN. The new local coerceNumber defaults to 0, changing arithmetic results for inputs like [null, 10]. This is a real value-semantics change hidden inside a 'types-only' refactor. Either preserve prior semantics or call it out explicitly.

issues.description: Public signatures take number[] but require non-empty; encode NonEmptyArray<number> at the type boundary.
issues.detail: Domain is typed number[] yet the body asserts isNonEmpty and throws. NonEmptyArray<T> is already defined and used by the peek overload but not on the public pan/zoom surface where it would pay rent. Pushing the constraint into the type would make the runtime guard belt-and-suspenders and eliminate duplicated checks.

issues.description: Patch bundles a runtime behavior change (empty-domain throw) with a typing refactor without separation.
issues.detail: The PR description claims same runtime behavior but adds a new throw on empty domain plus the null-to-zero coercion. These are independent semantic patches that deserve their own justification and tests, split from the .js-to-.ts rename and the peek overload. Splitting would make each change auditable.

issues.description: panLog/zoomLog read domain[0] before the non-empty guard runs inside pan/zoom.
issues.detail: Math.sign(domain[0]) executes on undefined when the domain is empty, producing NaN, before pan/zoom throws. The order is sloppy and the guard is implicitly duplicated. Move the non-empty check to the public entry (or to the type) so the value flow is linear.

issues.description: Local identity shadows the existing accessors.identity export, forking vocabulary.
issues.detail: vega-util already exports identity from accessors. Defining a narrower number=>number local identity, plus dropping the import, shadows an existing name with a different type. Either reuse the exported identity (cast if needed) or rename the local. Add a comment if the divergence is intentional pending TS migration.

issues.description: Empty-domain throw is tested only on panLinear/zoomLinear; six other entry points share the guard untested.
issues.detail: panLog, panPow, panSymlog, zoomLog, zoomPow, zoomSymlog all route through the same pan/zoom guard but have no coverage. A table-driven test across all eight public functions would discharge the invariant uniformly and protect against future divergence.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees this is a well-intentioned TypeScript port that quietly bundles two runtime behavior changes: a new empty-domain throw and a null-to-zero coercion in the new coerceNumber lift. The NonEmptyArray<T> type is defined but not used on the public pan/zoom surface where it would eliminate the runtime guard. Test coverage for the new throw hits only two of eight public entry points, and the local identity shadows the existing accessors export. Land after splitting the semantic changes from the typing refactor, encoding non-emptiness in the public signatures, and either preserving prior null/NaN semantics or documenting the intentional change.
